Job description:
We are looking for a creative, persistent, and results-oriented programmer who is interested in building Artificial Intelligence-based products and can transform ideas into real, usable tools and applications. The focus of this position is on product development, implementing ideas, building AI Agents, connecting various services, and professionally using AI in the development process. We do not expect complete mastery of all technologies in this field; problem-solving ability, fast learning, selecting appropriate solutions, and delivering the project to a result are more important to us. Main responsibilities • Transforming initial ideas and needs into actionable prototypes and real products • Designing the overall project structure and selecting a suitable technical solution • Building applications, AI-based tools, and AI Agents • Connecting AI models and various services via API • Developing and fixing Backend and Frontend parts of the projects • Researching and finding solutions for technical challenges • Testing, debugging, and delivering projects to usable outputs • Maintaining and developing product features after release • Providing regular and transparent reports on the progress of projects Desired Qualities • Ability to convert problems and ideas into practical solutions and understanding the main components of software products • Ability to independently advance the project and bring it to a conclusion • Problem-solving skills and finding answers through research and documentation • Professional use of AI tools for programming • Fast learning, accountability, follow-up, and time management • Ability to clearly explain decisions and technical solutions • Having at least one real-world sample, even in the form of a personal project • Required technical skills • Programming experience with at least one of Python or JavaScript/TypeScript • Familiarity with Backend, Frontend, and databases • Familiarity with frameworks and environments such as Next.js, FastAPI, Node.js, or similar • Familiarity with API, Webhook, Git, and code version control • Experience using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools • Familiarity with language models and concepts like AI Agent, Tool Calling, Context, and Memory Score is given for • Experience building AI Agents or LLM-based tools • Familiarity with MCP, n8n, or similar automation tools • General familiarity with RAG and Vector Database • Familiarity with Docker, Linux, or cloud services • Experience deploying projects and having GitHub or an online demo Collaboration Terms • Full-time and long-term; combination of office presence and remote work • Office location: West Tehran • Base monthly salary from 30 million Tomans, along with bonuses and commissions • Working on real projects and growth opportunities simultaneously with product development Please send your resume, portfolio link or GitHub, a description of your exact responsibilities in a project, the AI tools used, expected salary, and availability to start. Practical samples are prioritized for review.

Company description:
Marblein Tools Jewelry Company
